name: MWSButton
description: A versatile button component for triggering actions. Supports multiple variants, sizes, and states.

properties.name: variant
properties.description: The visual style variant of the button

properties.name: loading
properties.description: Whether to show a loading spinner

properties.name: fullWidth
properties.description: Whether the button should take full width

properties.name: iconLeft
properties.description: Icon name to show on the left side

properties.name: iconRight
properties.description: Icon name to show on the right side

properties.name: onPress
properties.description: Function called when the button is clicked

events.name: onPress
events.description: Fired when the button is clicked

events.name: onFocus
events.description: Fired when the button gains focus

events.name: onBlur
events.description: Fired when the button loses focus
